newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex benefits from longer opening hours.
newsitem.headline: Vendex benefits from longer opening hours.

text.p: Longer opening hours in the Netherlands gave a push to turnover at the specialty and department stores of Dutch retail and services group Vendex, board member Ed Hamming said on Tuesday.
"We are very happy with this development. In the stores that are open on Sundays, we make between ten and 15 percent of the weekly turnover on Sundays," he said.

Hamming said he estimated some eighty percent of the turnover made on Sundays was additional turnover. On a total annual basis, the effect of the Sunday openings on the department stores would add a few percent to sales, he said.
"At the moment, the number of stores open on Sundays is relatively limited, but I hope it will be expanded," he said.
Longer opening hours also had a positive effect on Vendex's food retail activities.
"It helps us to compete with cafes and restaurants," said board member Willy Angenent.
Additional turnover in food retail was likely somewhat less than 0.5 percent of total turnover, he said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Vendex announced a 30 percent rise in 1996/97 total net profit to 539 million guilders, while turnover totalled 12.145 billion guilders.
